title: Completion algebraization candidate on a fixed quasi-projective modification
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian ring complete for an ideal I, Z a Noetherian scheme, and f : Z → Spec A separated and of finite type. Let Q = I O_Z and G a coherent formal Q-module with degree-zero support proper over A. Given a proper q : Y → Z, n : ℕ, an immersion e of Y into P^n_A, and equality of its projection with q ≫ f, there exists a coherent module F on Y whose Q.comap q completion is isomorphic to the tensor pullback of G.

proof.text: Take X = e.image, p = e.imageι followed by the projective projection, and j = e.toImage. The quasi-compact immersion has an open image factor, its image inclusion is closed, and both X and Y are Noetherian by finite type over Spec A. The image factorization and he give j followed by p = q followed by f. Identify the ideal kernel of Spec(A/I) to Spec(A) with ofIdealTop(I) using ker_of_isAffine, ΓSpecIso_naturality, and Ideal.mk_ker.

Apply exists_chow_formal_system_extension to obtain a coherent formal module H on X and an isomorphism between the pulled G system and the restriction of H. This is the extension-by-zero part of the argument, without algebraization.

Apply completion_isEquivalence_of_projective_embedding to the closed immersion e.imageι. Essential surjectivity supplies a coherent module Fprime whose completion is isomorphic to H. All choices are local to the existential proof, with no definition choosing data from mere existence.

Use exists_formalSystemsPullback for j. Its coherent pullback functor C supplies F = C(Fprime). Map the component of its completion comparison through the full-subcategory inclusion, rewrite the underlying pulled system using the functor equality in that theorem, and rewrite the ideal using comap_comp and the equality j followed by p = q followed by f. Compose the extension isomorphism, the whiskered algebraization isomorphism, and this comparison to obtain the required system isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_chow_algebraization_core_candidate
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] (f : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (Q : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (hQ : Q = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Z Q)
    (hR : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.obj.obj (op 0)))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper q] (n : ℕ)
    (e : Y ⟶ ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) (Spec (.of A)))
    [IsImmersion e]
    (he : e ≫ (ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A)) =
      q ≫ f) :
    ∃ F : CoherentModules Y,
      Nonempty (G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (Q.comap q) F.obj)
